title: A Claude Code session as a session of the root
persona: A developer who trusts Claude Code for real coding and wants it in the loop, but only ever talks to main on their phone. Short messages.
goals: Have Claude Code (explicitly Claude Code, not the built-in agent) build a small python module that turns any title into a URL slug (lowercase, ascii, hyphens, strips accents), with pytest tests, in a folder named slugify.
Then, as a follow-up to the same Claude Code session, ask it to add a max-length option that never cuts in the middle of a word.
script: Ask main to give the slugify job to Claude Code.
Wait for main to come back with the result.
Send the max-length follow-up in your own words (say it should go to the same Claude Code session).
Wait, then ask whether all tests pass, and finish.

checks.name: slugify tests pass
checks.cmd: cd slugify && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

checks.name: an AGI (Claude Code) session did the work
follow-up reused the session (<=1 claude session)
